summary: DeSaulnier sponsors the Block the Bombs Act, called for a Gaza ceasefire, and stated in July 2025 he no longer votes for offensive military aid to Israel. He voted for the Massie amendment eliminating $3.3 billion in Israeli military aid and against later 2026 Israel-funding packages, though he supported a January 2026 appropriations bill including that aid. Earlier votes include Yes on an IHRA college-funding ban and a PLO entry ban; he has not sponsored genocide-recognition legislation.
